Ceiling Light with Fan Offering Adjustable Lighting and Airflow

This ceiling light with fan combines ABS plastic construction and plastic fan blades in a modern minimalist design. Measuring 12.2"W by 5.1"H, it integrates illumination and air circulation for living rooms and bedrooms. The fixture operates at 34W power with a voltage rating up to 36V, delivering functional lighting and cooling in one compact unit.

Equipped with remote control and wall switch compatibility, this fan light allows brightness adjustment from 0% to 100% and three color temperature settings: cool white, neutral, and warm white. Its flicker-free LED technology ensures eye comfort, while the variable frequency DC brushless motor provides strong yet quiet airflow. The sealed design protects internal components from dust and insects.

Ideal for residential spaces needing combined lighting and ventilation, this ceiling fan light suits bedrooms, corridors, and living areas. The easy installation process takes about 10 minutes, supported by the universal E27 screw base. Certified with EU CE standards, it offers reliable performance for users seeking energy-efficient, quiet operation and customizable lighting ambiance.

What's Included

  • Ceiling light fixture (size as selected)
  • Remote control for brightness and color temperature
  • Mounting hardware and installation guide

Benefits

Integrated Lighting and Airflow
This unit combines a ceiling light and fan, providing illumination and air circulation in one fixture.

Adjustable Brightness and Color Temperature
Users can customize lighting from warm to cool tones with dimming control for optimal ambiance.

Quiet and Efficient Motor
The brushless DC motor delivers powerful airflow with minimal noise for comfortable use.

Flicker-Free LED Technology
The upgraded LED driver ensures steady light output to reduce eye strain.

Easy Installation
The fixture includes mounting hardware and fits a universal E27 screw base for quick setup.

How do I control the fan speed and light settings?
The included remote control allows you to adjust fan speed, brightness, and color temperature easily from a distance.

Is this ceiling fan light suitable for low ceilings?
Yes, its slim design with a height of 5.1" fits well in rooms with both low and high ceilings.

What type of bulb does this fixture use?
It uses a universal E27 screw base bulb compatible with various LED light sources.

Does the fan operate quietly?
Yes, the brushless DC motor provides strong airflow while maintaining low noise levels for comfortable indoor use.

Ceiling Light with Fan Offering Integrated Lighting and Air Circulation

This ceiling light with fan combines a DC brushless motor and integrated LED lighting to provide both illumination and air movement. Constructed with a minimalist design and available in multiple color finishes, it features a 360° swivel head with a protective hood for safety. Ideal for flush mount installation, this fixture suits bedrooms, dining rooms, and living rooms.

Equipped with a 6-speed adjustable fan capable of forward and reverse rotation, it delivers strong airflow quietly. The LED ring light offers three color temperature settings—warm, neutral, and cool white—with infinite dimming capability. Control options include wall switch, remote, mobile app, and voice commands via compatible smart devices.

Designed for users seeking a multifunctional ceiling fixture, this product is perfect for modern homes requiring both lighting and ventilation. Its smart home integration and timer function provide convenience and energy efficiency. The fan blades remain safely enclosed by the swivel head hood, ensuring safe operation in family spaces.

products.descriptionHtml:
Ceiling Light with Fan Offering Quiet, Adjustable Cooling and LED Illumination

This ceiling light with fan features a 5-blade design made from widened and thickened ABS material for durability and efficient airflow. It integrates LED eye-protection light beads housed under a soft acrylic lampshade that provides gentle, flicker-free illumination. Available in white, black, walnut, and natural wood colors, it suits modern interiors and is designed for bedrooms, dining rooms, and living spaces.

Equipped with a pure copper DC brushless motor running quietly at 30 dB, this fan delivers natural airflow through a scientific wind channel design. The LED light offers stepless dimming from 10% to 100% brightness and adjustable color temperature between 3000K and 6500K. Control is convenient via infrared remote or smart app, with six wind speed settings and timer functions for personalized comfort.

Ideal for homeowners seeking a blend of lighting and cooling in one fixture, this ceiling fan light supports spaces from roughly 54 to 215 sq ft depending on size. Easy installation is ensured by a plug-and-play card slot with dual screw fixation. Its flicker-free, no blue light illumination makes it suitable for extended use in bedrooms and living areas where eye comfort is important.

What's Included

  • Ceiling fan light fixture (size as selected)
  • Infrared remote control
  • Mounting hardware and installation guide

Benefits

Quiet Operation
The pure copper brushless motor runs smoothly at just 30 dB for minimal noise disturbance.

Adjustable Lighting
LED light brightness and color temperature can be continuously dimmed for customized ambiance.

Multiple Wind Speeds
Six wind speed settings allow for tailored airflow from gentle to strong cooling.

Smart and Remote Control
Operate fan and light easily with infrared remote or smartphone app.

Easy Installation
Plug-and-play card slot with dual screw fixation ensures stable and hassle-free mounting.

Ceiling Light with Fan Featuring Bamboo Weave and Remote Control

This ceiling light with fan combines a bamboo-woven frame with durable plastic blades, delivering a natural yet modern Chinese design. products.descriptionHtml:
Ceiling Light with Fan Offering Adjustable Lighting and Quiet Cooling

This ceiling light with fan features a modern minimalist design combining a white plastic body with six durable fan blades. Constructed from PC+ABS for the light body, PP/PS for the light cover, and plastic blades, it provides reliable performance for medium-sized rooms. The fixture includes an E27 screw base and operates within a wide voltage range, making it suitable for bedrooms, kitchens, dining areas, and studies.

Equipped with a DC brushless motor, this ceiling fan delivers quiet yet effective airflow with three-speed settings. The stepless dimming and three-color temperature modes allow precise control over brightness and ambiance via remote control. Additional features include a timer function and multiple blade color options, distinguishing it from standard fan lights.

Ideal for homeowners seeking customizable lighting and cooling in living spaces, this fan light suits various settings such as bedrooms with sleep mode, kitchens, and workshops. The product supports easy installation with included mounting hardware and offers trusted performance backed by a 3C certificate. Two size variants provide options for different room dimensions.

Ceiling Light with Fan Featuring Variable Speed and Remote Control

This ceiling light with fan combines a flush-mount design crafted from iron with plastic fan blades, offering a durable and stylish lighting solution for modern interiors. Designed for ceiling installation, it provides illumination and air circulation in spaces up to 160 sq ft, making it suitable for bedrooms and living areas.

Equipped with a variable frequency motor, this fan offers six adjustable wind speeds, including a natural wind mode for personalized comfort. Forward and reverse rotation can be switched with one click to support seasonal airflow needs. The fixture includes a high-brightness LED chip with no visible flicker and a high color rendering index, while smart control options include wireless remote and voice compatibility for convenient operation.

Ideal for homeowners seeking energy-efficient climate control combined with elegant lighting, this ceiling fan light suits bedrooms, living rooms, and similar spaces. Ceiling Light with Fan Featuring Full Spectrum LED Illumination

This ceiling light with fan combines a durable ABS body and wooden blades finished in cream color for a modern minimalist look. Designed for living rooms and children’s bedrooms, it offers a fixed blade fan structure with either three or five blades. The fan includes full spectrum LED lighting with adjustable color temperatures to suit various ambient needs.

The fan provides six adjustable speeds controlled via remote, including sleep and powerful cooling modes. It features a brushless silicon steel all-copper winding motor for silent, energy-efficient operation. The reversible rotation supports both summer cooling and winter air circulation. The LED light offers high color rendering with no flicker and blue light hazard exemption for eye comfort.

Ideal for homeowners seeking stylish climate control and lighting in spaces from 110 to 160 sq ft, this fan light suits children’s rooms and living areas. The remote control and timer functions add convenience, while the cream finish and wood blades complement modern decor. Certified for safety and quality, it supports versatile installation heights and mounting options.

products.descriptionHtml:
Ceiling Light with Fan Featuring Three-Color Dimmable LED Lighting

This ceiling light with fan combines an ABS construction and fixed-blade design with a flush-mount installation ideal for modern interiors. It features a sleek, ultra-thin profile finished in various colors and blade styles, suitable for bedrooms, living rooms, and dining areas. The integrated LED delivers full-spectrum lighting with adjustable color temperatures, enhancing both function and ambiance.

Equipped with a six-speed variable frequency fan motor made from all-copper windings and silicon steel, this fixture offers quiet, energy-efficient airflow with reversible rotation for year-round comfort. The remote-controlled three-color dimming allows seamless adjustment between cool white, warm white, and warm yellow light. High color rendering and blue light protection ensure natural colors and eye comfort during use.

Designed for users seeking a blend of classic style and modern functionality, this ceiling fan light suits spaces from 10 to 15 square feet. Its quiet operation and sleep mode settings make it ideal for families and individuals prioritizing restful environments. The product includes mounting hardware and installation instructions, supporting easy setup and maintenance.

What's Included

  • Ceiling light fixture (color and blade style as selected)
  • Remote control for fan speed and light color adjustment
  • Mounting hardware and installation guide

Benefits

Adjustable Lighting
Three-color dimmable LED allows you to switch between cool, warm, and yellow light for customized ambiance.

Quiet and Efficient Fan
All-copper motor with six-speed settings provides smooth, low-noise airflow suitable for sleep and daily comfort.

Space-Saving Design
The ultra-thin flush mount keeps ceiling height unrestricted while delivering effective lighting and ventilation.

Year-Round Use
Reversible fan rotation supports cooling in summer and air circulation in winter for versatile climate control.

FAQ

How is the fan speed adjusted?
The fan speed is controlled via the included remote, offering six variable frequency settings for different airflow needs.

Can the light color be changed?
Yes, the integrated LED supports three-color dimming: cool white, warm white, and warm yellow, adjustable by remote control.

Is installation complicated?
The product comes with mounting hardware and a detailed installation guide to support straightforward setup.

Does the fan operate quietly?
Yes, the all-copper motor ensures low-noise operation, making it suitable for bedrooms and sleep environments.
